build_mlp_layer: build a two-layer MLP with GELU activation and configurable hidden features for a vision transformer model
create_mlp_with_dropout: create an MLP layer with dropout regularization between fc1 and fc2 linear layers
test_mlp_forward: test the Mlp forward pass by passing a tensor through fc1, activation, dropout, fc2, and dropout
refactor_mlp_activation: refactor the Mlp class to swap the default GELU activation layer with ReLU or SiLU
review_mlp_bias_config: review the Mlp class to understand how bias is applied to both fc1 and fc2 linear layers
